transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because... I'm just so tired. It's like my body is filled with wet sand. I can barely get through a shift at work anymore, and resting doesn't really seem to help.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I don't really know. I guess... I haven't really thought about it like that. I just know I'm tired.
Do you find yourself enjoying things you used to like?

Not really. Um... things just feel kind of flat. Like... I usually like cooking, or playing my guitar... hiking, going to see my family. But lately... I don't know. It just feels like I'm only pretending to care about any of it.
Do you feel like you're able to experience pleasure when you're doing things, even if you're not really looking forward to them?
No... not really. Even when I force myself to do something... like picking up my guitar or cooking... it's just going through the motions. There's no... feeling to it. It's just flat.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself?

Um... I don't know. I mean... I wouldn't actually do anything. But... sometimes I just think... maybe it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. Like everyone would be better off. And... I don't know, a couple of times walking home from work, I just... I caught myself looking at the traffic and thinking about just... stepping off the curb. But I didn't. I just thought about it.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... I guess... about four months? Just feeling this... low. It's been a while since... well, a long time after I had that first rush of energy at work, it just kind of... stopped. So yeah, about four months of just... feeling empty.
Have you noticed any changes in your movement or activity level, like feeling restless or slowed down?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's different now. Before... when I had that energy, I couldn't stop moving. I was always pacing around the store, straightening shelves, just constantly doing something. But now... it's the opposite. Everything just feels... heavy. Even just walking to the bus stop or... or trying to answer a customer's question... it takes so much effort. I just feel really... slow.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?

Um... I guess so. I haven't really been paying attention but... my work pants are definitely looser. I just... I forget to eat mostly. Or when I do, it just... it tastes like cardboard, so I don't really bother. It's just... been all over the place.
Have you experienced any strange or unusual thoughts, like hearing voices or seeing things that others can't?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's... it's hard to explain. At work, at the register... I started hearing things. Like... voices. It sounded like customers were standing right behind me, whispering my name. Or... saying I was messing everything up. But... whenever I turned around, nobody was there. It was just... empty.
Have you been having any thoughts that you think are not your own or that are being controlled by someone or something else?
No... no, nothing like that. Just... just the voices. I don't feel like anyone is controlling me or anything. It's just... my own thoughts, I guess. And the whispering. That's all.
Have you had any periods in the past four months where you felt significantly better for at least a couple of weeks?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I haven't... I haven't really felt better. It's just been... kind of the same. I don't know.
Have you been having any other unusual experiences, like seeing things that aren't really there, in addition to the voices you mentioned?
No... I haven't seen anything. Just... just the whispering. Nothing else.
Have you experienced any other hallucinations besides the voices you mentioned?
No. Just... just the voices. I already said that. There's nothing else.
Do you feel like you're moving slower than you used to, or is it more that you just don't feel like doing things?

I guess... it's slower. It changed. At first, I couldn't stop pacing around the store. Just... straightening things all the time. But lately... I don't know. Everything just feels heavy. Like... even just walking to the bus, or... trying to answer a question. It's just really slow.
Have you had any other unusual experiences, like feeling that someone is controlling your thoughts or actions?
No... I don't... nobody is doing that. It's just me.
Have you experienced any periods where the voices you heard were more than just whispering your name or criticizing you, but rather a conversation or distinct voices talking to each other?
No... I haven't heard that. They don't... they don't talk to each other. It's just what I already told you.
Have you experienced any other hallucinations besides hearing voices?

No... just the voices. Like I was saying... when I was at the register, it sounded like customers were standing right behind me. Whispering my name, or... saying I was messing everything up. I'd turn around and nobody was there. But... no. Nothing else. Just that.
Have you ever felt like the voices you heard were real, like they were coming from outside your head?
I don't know... I mean, like I said, I thought people were standing right behind me. So... I guess so. I don't really know how else to explain it.
Did you ever think the voices were real, coming from outside your head, at any point?
I... I think I just answered that. Yeah. Like I said, I thought they were real customers standing right behind me. I don't really know what else to tell you.
